name: daylight-explorer-styles-meshy
comment: The same twelve styles through Meshy (Colby: "we can use the meshy api perhaps?"): nano-banana-2, 6 prepaid credits a still, the same two references, so the two generators can be compared cell by cell.
subject: A 16:9 film frame, medium-wide, three-quarter view from behind: the Daylight explorer, an elderly British gentleman (khaki pith helmet, big white walrus moustache, a single gold-rimmed monocle on a fine chain over one eye, many-pocketed khaki safari jacket, leather satchel on a shoulder strap, green trousers, sturdy laced boots, a wooden cane) walks along a pine-forest ridge path at golden hour toward snow-capped mountains; a log cabin with lit windows sits below among the pines; low sun, long warm shadows, haze between the ridges. His identity follows the first reference image (face, helmet, moustache, monocle); the world follows the second.
negative: text, letters, logos, watermark, real people, extra limbs, spectacles or a second lens

styles.label: Soft painterly 3D (clip one)
styles.style: Soft painterly 3D animation look: a rounded, stylised character with soft subsurface shading and no hard outlines, matte-painting brushwork in the world, cinematic shallow depth of field, warm rim light, volumetric haze, fine film grain.

styles.label: Flat cel-shaded cartoon
styles.style: Flat cel-shaded cartoon: bold clean black outlines, two-tone shading, saturated flat colours, a Saturday-morning animation look, simple graphic background.

styles.label: Storybook watercolour
styles.style: Storybook watercolour on cold-pressed paper: loose translucent washes, visible paper grain, soft bleeding edges, fine ink line accents, a muted warm palette.

styles.label: Hand-painted anime feature
styles.style: Hand-painted anime feature-film look: gouache skies with soft cloud shapes, lush painted foliage, a simply drawn character with expressive clean line and flat colour, warm nostalgic light.

styles.label: Stop-motion claymation
styles.style: Stop-motion claymation: a sculpted plasticine character with visible fingerprints, a miniature set of felt trees and a painted backdrop, tilt-shift focus, warm studio lighting.

styles.label: Mid-century screen print
styles.style: Mid-century screen print, risograph poster: a limited palette of four inks, halftone textures, slight misregistration, bold simplified shapes, cream paper.

styles.label: Ink and wash comic
styles.style: Ink and wash comic illustration: confident brush-ink lines, grey and sepia washes, one spot colour on the sunset, cross-hatching in the shadows.

styles.label: 16-bit pixel art
styles.style: 16-bit pixel art: a detailed SNES-era scene, dithered gradients in the sky, a crisp sprite character, pixel-perfect edges.

styles.label: Paper cut-out diorama
styles.style: Layered paper cut-out diorama: every element a cut sheet of textured card with real drop shadows, tiny paper pines, a paper sun, photographed with a macro lens.

styles.label: 1950s travel poster
styles.style: Vintage 1950s national-park travel poster: flat graphic shapes, textured lithograph print, dramatic simplified mountains, a bold warm palette.

styles.label: Low-poly 3D
styles.style: Low-poly 3D render: faceted geometry, flat-shaded triangles, soft global illumination, a clean stylised game look.

styles.label: CRT vault-boy (the mascot's native look)
styles.style: The mascot's native look: a 1950s pin-up cartoon character in a retro CRT vault-boy style, thick clean lines, seen through an old monitor with scanlines, phosphor glow and slight barrel distortion.
